text:
We can confirm that Mireille Ashgrove won this year’s Calder Vane Prize for architecture, announced at the Rillhouse Forum on Thursday. In our review of the judging note, the panel praised her work on modular civic housing and low-carbon retrofits, especially the way she balanced cost control with daylighting and structural reuse. We saw the final shortlist after the jury session and the award was settled in the third round of voting.

Key facts:
- Winner: Mireille Ashgrove
- Prize: Calder Vane Prize for architecture
- Announcement date: 14 November
- Venue: Rillhouse Forum, North Quay
- Winning project: the Lorne Yard Housing Envelope
- Jury citation: “clear technical rigor and humane spatial planning”
